test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Water is pouring into a cuboidal reservoir at the rate of 50 litres per minute. The volume of the reservoir is 120 m³, How many hours will it take to fill the reservoir?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of pouring water = 50 litres per minute.

Volume of the reservoir = 120 m³ = 120,000 litres. (Since 1m³ = 1000 litres)

**Formula Used:**

Time = Volume / Rate

**Calculation:**

Volume of the reservoir = 120,000 litres

Rate of pouring = 50 litres/minute

⇒ Time in minutes = 120,000 / 50

⇒ Time in minutes = 2400 minutes

Since there are 60 minutes in an hour,

⇒ Time in hours = 2400 / 60

⇒ Time in hours = 40

**It will take 40 hours to fill the reservoir.**
